description: A privacy-first QR and barcode scanner with 6-layer link safety checks, sandboxed page preview, physical tamper (quishing) detection, hidden StegoQR content, smart actions for Wi-Fi/contacts/payments/2FA, encrypted scan history, AR CodeVision multi-code tracking, and offline AirQR data transfer.
